name: Laura Mínguez Serrano
title: Principal UX/UI Designer
summary: Principal UX/UI Designer with 12+ years of experience leading product design strategy for SaaS, fintech, and consumer platforms. Known for turning complex user journeys into elegant, accessible interfaces and for building scalable design systems that improve consistency, speed up delivery, and support measurable business growth.

bullets: Led end-to-end product design across 4 cross-functional squads, improving task completion rates by 18% in 12 months.
Built and governed a design system used by 30+ product teams, reducing UI delivery time by 35%.
Directed quarterly research and usability testing programs with 120+ participants, informing roadmap decisions and prioritization.
Mentored 6 designers and established critique rituals that increased design consistency across platforms.
Redesigned the onboarding and payment flows for a mobile-first fintech app, increasing activation by 22%.
Partnered with product and engineering to ship 3 major releases with a 97% on-time delivery rate.
Created accessible responsive interfaces aligned with WCAG 2.1 AA, reducing support tickets related to usability by 28%.
Standardized interaction patterns and component libraries, cutting review cycles by 40%.
Led discovery and journey mapping for B2B workflow software used by enterprise clients in 8 countries.
Introduced prototyping and iterative testing early in the cycle, helping reduce rework after development by 30%.
Collaborated with research and analytics to identify friction points that improved retention by 15%.
Designed web and mobile interfaces for digital services in retail and travel sectors.
Produced wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups for features delivered to 500K+ users.
Supported stakeholder workshops and translated business goals into user-centered requirements.
